question: The inflation rate of November 28, 2008
query: SELECT date, inflation_rate FROM finance_economics_dataset WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2008 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) = 11 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date) <= 30; -- Assuming November has at most 30 days for simplicity.
